qualityReview.identity: Preserves white braid, androgynous adult face, high ivory coat, turquoise mechanisms, black gloves and floating segmented golden hourglass.
qualityReview.scene: Suspended rain and crystal fragments communicate stopped time; wet foreground platform, observatory armatures and distant mountains create depth with twilight and gold illumination.
qualityReview.composition: Face, outstretched glove and hourglass in upper half; two boots ground the full character.
qualityReview.constraints: Opaque illustration; no text, UI, frame, logo or watermark seen. Floor geometry is nonlinguistic.
